digest.component_or_area: test/external integration — live Jira Cloud S3-backed reconciliation harness
propositions: A new read-only live test suite validates Jira Cloud multi-project reconciliation (REB + DIG projects) against an isolated S3-backed store, exercising compute_snapshot (inbound fetch) and bridge_preview (dry-run) with zero mutations to Cloud.

Structural enforcement prevents all outbound Jira mutations: an autouse fixture monkeypatches 18 mutating AcliClient methods to raise JiraWriteForbidden, and per-project issue counts are asserted identical before and after each scenario.
The isolated S3 store has only a throwaway git-remote-s3 prefix as its remote, with REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off and minimal content; the prefix is deleted in teardown to prevent production contact.

Multi-project fetch scoping is validated: a REB+DIG mapping yields real volume from both projects (~2160 issues) with correct per-project attribution; a single-project mapping yields only that project's issues with zero cross-contamination.
Unknown mapped project keys fail closed: an unmapped or unreachable project key causes compute_snapshot to raise, never silently succeeding.

The test suite is integrated into CI as a dedicated manually-dispatched jira-cloud-s3-rehearsal job, gated on REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL and AWS_S3_REHEARSAL_ROLE_ARN; the general external job excludes the new directory to prevent double-collection.
